title: Ana BeKoach
subtitle: The Forty-Two Letter Name
note: A seven-line Kabbalistic prayer attributed to Rabbi Nechunya ben HaKanah. According to Kabbalistic tradition, the initial letters of the prayer's forty-two words correspond to the Forty-Two-Letter Name of God.

lines.english: Please, with the great strength of Your right hand, release the bound.
Accept Your people's song; elevate and purify us, O Awesome One.
Please, Mighty One, guard like the pupil of the eye those who seek Your Oneness.
Bless them, purify them; may Your righteous compassion always reward them.
Mighty and Holy One, in Your abundant goodness lead Your congregation.
Only and Exalted One, turn to Your people who proclaim Your holiness.
Accept our plea and hear our cry, O Knower of secrets.

seal.english: Blessed is the Name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever.
seal.note: Recited quietly after the seven lines.
